markets.rules_primary: If Rome Gladiators wins the Rome Gladiators vs Venice Livewire men's professional Italia T10 cricket match originally scheduled for Nov 23, 2026 at 6:00 AM EST, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
If the Rome Gladiators vs Venice Livewire men's professional Italia T10 cricket match originally scheduled for Nov 23, 2026 at 6:00 AM EST ends in a tie, draw, no result (NR), abandonment, or cancellation, and no official winner is declared, all markets will resolve to $0.50.
In the event of a forfeit, disqualification, or concession:
  If it occurs before the match begins, all markets will resolve to $0.50.
